hypothesis/category: baseline capture can publish healthy before complete
concrete_evidence: all transforms/material are required; optional clip/palette validity is recorded; mutex publishes complete snapshot before healthy release

hypothesis/category: failed baseline capture leaves partially promoted Ex device
concrete_evidence: failure marks unhealthy, abandons compat device, clears hooks and baseline, returns false

hypothesis/category: Reset ownership can overlap legacy and stereo hooks
concrete_evidence: legacy Reset hook is disarmed before synchronous stereo install; failed handoff rejects Ex promotion

hypothesis/category: pre-Reset D3DSBT_ALL object is replayed after ResetEx
concrete_evidence: current focus contains no pre-Reset state-block replay; R13 explicit replay then R15 explicit extra replay is authoritative

hypothesis/category: stereo may run during incomplete reset replay
concrete_evidence: safety block is asserted before lower Reset call and released only when coreHealthy&&extraHealthy

hypothesis/category: extra baseline silently succeeds without captured snapshot
concrete_evidence: ready is checked under mutex; missing snapshot returns false and keeps reset unhealthy

hypothesis/category: shader constants are zeroed beyond device capability
concrete_evidence: vertex float count is capped by MaxVertexShaderConst/256 and integer/bool families are gated on shader major version

hypothesis/category: partial hook transaction remains active on enable failure
concrete_evidence: any missing/failed hook calls rollback and leaves final compat overlay not ready

hypothesis/category: GenerateMipSubLevels leaves stale lower-mip CPU validity
concrete_evidence: valid/dirty masks retain only level0; lower lockRect validity cleared; concurrent lock marks retire pending

hypothesis/category: failed partial upload can corrupt unrelated texels via whole-level fallback
concrete_evidence: whole-level fallback is allowed only when lockRectValid is false; partial failure invalidates and retires shadow

hypothesis/category: host state can omit lifecycle identity needed to reject stale pose
concrete_evidence: HostState carries referenceSpaceGeneration and directTransportGeneration alongside poseId and predictedDisplayTime; architecture requires host-only writer

hypothesis/category: consumer may submit a newer pose than image render pose
concrete_evidence: FrameDescriptor binds frameId, renderPoseId, presentQpc and renderedEyes in one fixed wire object

hypothesis/category: ACK can release a slot from a different transport generation
concrete_evidence: AckState carries transportGeneration, consumedFrameId and consumedSlot; exact producer-side comparison remains required when v3 becomes live

hypothesis/category: x86 pointer width can truncate x64-consumed shared handles
concrete_evidence: WireHandle is uint64_t with sizeof==8 static assertion; wire structs are packed and size asserted

hypothesis/category: transport reset has no explicit producer invalidation contract
concrete_evidence: IFrameProducer exposes invalidate() separately from publish(), giving reset/session transitions an ownership boundary

hypothesis/category: consumer acknowledgement API can lose slot/generation identity
concrete_evidence: interface acknowledge accepts frameId only while FrameSlot contains generation+slot; v3 AckState is richer, so adapter implementation must not collapse identity

hypothesis/category: session invalidation can be implicit and leave stale swapchain resources
concrete_evidence: interface provides invalidateSessionResources(), beginFrame/endFrame and submission boundaries; concrete call ordering still needs review

hypothesis/category: recenter can reuse pose identity across reference-space generations
concrete_evidence: RenderPose carries poseId plus referenceSpaceGeneration and validity bits; consumers must compare generation at latch/use boundaries

hypothesis/category: host loss may leave StereoAllowed true
concrete_evidence: FailClosed clears HostFresh, HostRenderable and StereoAllowed and rearms RecoveryPending; unavailable overlay delegates to it

hypothesis/category: fresh host alone may reopen stereo before a post-reset baseline
concrete_evidence: BaselineVerified requires overlay+fresh+renderable and no external block; MayInjectStereo additionally requires StereoAllowed and !RecoveryPending
